pub trait Shape {
    fn area(&self) -> f64;
    fn label(&self) -> String {
        String::from("shape")
    }
}

pub struct Square {
    side: f64,
}

impl Shape for Square {
    fn area(&self) -> f64 {
        self.side * self.side
    }
}

impl Square {
    pub fn new() -> Square {
        Square { side: 1.0 }
    }

    fn dead_method(&self) {}
}

pub struct Unused;

#[no_mangle]
pub extern "C" fn ffi_entry() {}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    #[test]
    fn square_area() {
        assert_helper();
    }

    fn assert_helper() {}
}
